title: What If Half the World's Languages Vanished?

scenes.text: What if half the world's languages vanished? Most people wouldn't notice at first.
About 7,000 languages are spoken today, but just 23 are used by more than half the world's population.
Half of all languages are spoken by fewer than 8,000 people each.
At least 43 percent are already endangered, and UNESCO forecasts that 50 to 90 percent of indigenous languages could disappear by the end of this century.
When a language dies, everything only it could say goes too.
You may have heard one dies every two weeks. Statisticians say that exact rate is shaky, but the trend is not.
